messages:
Ava (CS): Quick sync from BrightSpark onboarding call — they called out two things that are causing renewal nervousness:
- No per-route cost breakdown in Console (they want to see per-feature spend)
- Difficulty pinning model versions for alpha vs prod

Customer asked for: a) a per-route billing toggle / CSV export b) UI to pin models per-app

Miguel (Eng): noted. Per-route export might be doable as a CSV from usage API. I'll prototype endpoint: `GET /v1/usage?group_by=route` — could we expose in Console? :thinking:

Jonah (PM): Thanks. Can you add the proto to the product board? This is mid-priority for Q2 renewal. CS flagged as "at-risk" if not addressed. Also tagging design for a small UX.

Priya (Design): I can draft a small modal for per-route toggle and a model pin dropdown. Need sample data. Ava — can you share a screenshot or example route names? :slightly_smiling_face:

Ava (CS): Sending sample routes: `onboard_flow`, `api:chat`, `billing-embed`. Also they suggested export with columns: route, date, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd. Here's a paste of their request:
```
We need to show each product team's spend by route and allow us to export monthly CSVs. Also let us pin a stable model for prod and an auto-updating model for canaries.
```

Jonah (PM): Proposal: P2 — shipping CSV export + model pin UI. If eng can ship CSV API in 2 sprints, we'll add UI in same cycle. I'll own product spec.

Miguel (Eng): OK. I'll open a spike and attach rough ETA. If we do server-side aggregation we'll avoid huge client queries. @Ava (CS) can you mark BrightSpark renewal date and send to renewals doc?

Ava (CS): Yep, renewal 2026-08-15. Adding to renewals tracker. Also requesting an enablement walkthrough for their engineering leads once we have the UI.

Jonah (PM): Cool. Action items:
- Miguel: spike for usage export (ETA 2w)
- Priya: mockups (ETA 1w)
- Ava: paste sample data + update renewals tracker
I'll create product board card and tag everyone. :white_check_mark:

system-bot: Created card RF-342 on Product Board (https://productboard.internal/rf-342) by Jonah.

Ava (CS): thanks all. Will follow up with customer mid-next-week.
